# Qwen3.8-Flash: Free for a Limited Time

Qwen3.8-Flash is a multimodal model in the Qwen family that balances response speed and cost, with support for coding, long-document processing, and image understanding. It also supports tool calling, making it suitable for everyday development, organizing information, and automation tasks.

Starting September 18, 2026 at 10:00, **Qwen3.8-Flash is free for a limited time** for all new and existing individual users of Qoder International. During the promotion, calls to this model consume no Credits, with the Credit rate reduced from **0.1× to 0.0×**. No claim is required: simply select the model to use it for free. **Free accounts and accounts with a zero Credits balance are also eligible.**

> **Extended**: The free period, originally set to end on September 30, has been extended. **Qwen3.8-Flash remains free after September 30.** No action is needed: keep selecting Qwen3.8-Flash as usual. We will announce the end date on this page in advance.

All times in this article are in Singapore Time (UTC+8).

## Promotion Details

- **Promotion period**: Starts September 18, 2026 at 10:00. Originally scheduled to end September 30, 2026 at 23:59:59, the promotion has been extended beyond that date. The end date will be announced on this page in advance.
- **Eligibility**: All new and existing individual users of Qoder International, including users on Free, Pro Trial, Pro, Pro+, and Ultra plans. Teams and Enterprise subscribers are not eligible.
- **Eligible model**: Qwen3.8-Flash.
- **Offer**: The model's Credit rate is reduced from 0.1× to 0.0×. Calls to this model consume no Credits.
- **Activation**: The offer applies automatically, with no claim required. You can use the model even with a zero Credits balance.

Qwen3.8-Flash is experiencing high demand during the promotion, and responses may be slower at peak times. Please allow extra time or try again later.

## Eligible Products

This promotion applies to the following Qoder International products:

- Qoder
- Qoder IDE
- Qoder JetBrains plugin
- Qoder CLI
- QoderWake
- Qoder Cloud Agents
- Qoder Mobile
- Qoder web app

## How to Use

1. Create or sign in to a Qoder International individual account.
2. Select **Qwen3.8-Flash** as the model in the product you are using.
3. Start using the model. Calls to it consume no Credits during the promotion.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### The offer was set to end on September 30. Is Qwen3.8-Flash still free after that?

Yes. The free period has been extended. From October 1, keep selecting Qwen3.8-Flash as usual. There is nothing to claim and no setting to change. We will announce the end date on this page in advance.

### Do I need a paid subscription?

No. Free individual users are also eligible. You can select and use Qwen3.8-Flash even with a zero Credits balance.

### Are other models free too?

This offer applies only to Qwen3.8-Flash. Other models and tiers remain subject to their respective pricing and promotional rules.

### Will using this model consume the 100 general-purpose Credits I claim each day?

During the promotion, calls to Qwen3.8-Flash consume no Credits and do not deduct from the 100 general-purpose Credits you claim each day. Claimed Credits still expire according to their respective validity periods.

### How will usage be charged after the promotion ends?

We will announce the end date of the free period on this page in advance. After it ends, usage will be charged at the model's Credit rate published at that time.

If you have any questions, please contact [contact@qoder.com](mailto:contact@qoder.com).
